Name: Artisan's Outfit
Description: Sturdy work clothes worn by craftspeople, including apron, durable tunic, and practical footwear. Suitable for any trade or craft.

Name: Battle Mask
Description: Intimidating mask worn in combat to frighten enemies and protect the face. Often decorated with fierce designs.

Name: Billow Cape
Description: Dramatic cape designed to billow impressively in the wind. Popular among performers and those seeking to make grand entrances.

Name: Bogwalking Sandals
Description: Special sandals with broad soles that distribute weight, allowing easier movement through swamps, bogs, and marshes.

Name: Brooch
Description: Decorative pin for fastening cloaks or adorning clothing. Cost varies by materials and craftsmanship.

Name: Burglar's Outfit
Description: Dark, close-fitting clothing designed for stealth. Includes soft boots, dark hood, and clothing with many hidden pockets.

Name: Caul
Description: Decorative hairnet or cap, often jeweled. Cost varies from simple to elaborate designs.

Name: Chain Belt
Description: Decorative belt made of metal chain links, fashionable and sturdy.

Name: Chausses
Description: Medieval leg coverings, similar to tights or hose, worn under armor or as everyday legwear.

Name: Cleats
Description: Spiked attachments for boots providing better traction on ice, mud, or steep slopes.

Name: Cleric's Vestments
Description: Ceremonial robes worn by clerics during religious services, adorned with holy symbols.

Name: Cold-Weather Outfit
Description: Heavy furs, thick boots, and insulated clothing for surviving arctic conditions. Grants bonuses against cold weather.

Name: Cork Vest
Description: Buoyant vest filled with cork, helps the wearer float in water.

Name: Corset
Description: Structured undergarment or outer garment. Cost varies from practical to elaborate, jeweled designs.

Name: Courtesan's Outfit
Description: Alluring, fashionable clothing designed to attract attention and seduce.

Name: Courtier's Outfit
Description: Fine clothing suitable for noble courts, including rich fabrics, jewelry, and fashionable accessories.

Name: Covenant Rings
Description: Matching pair of rings symbolizing a sacred bond, often used in marriages or partnerships.

Name: Cushion Inserts
Description: Padding inserted into clothing to alter appearance or provide comfort.

Name: Dancer's Garb
Description: Flowing, colorful clothing designed for performance, allowing freedom of movement.

Name: Dancer's Garb, Silver
Description: Premium dancer's outfit adorned with silver bells, coins, or trim that jingles melodiously.

Name: Decorative Trim
Description: Ornamental edging for clothing like lace, fringe, or embroidery. Cost varies by quality.

Name: Dilettante's Outfit
Description: Fashionable but impractical clothing worn by wealthy youth pretending to pursue various interests.

Name: Diving Suit
Description: Waterproof outfit for underwater work, though primitive compared to modern diving equipment.

Name: Elven Prosthetics
Description: Masterfully crafted false ears that make non-elves appear elven. Nearly indistinguishable from real elven ears.

Name: Emissary's Sash
Description: Ornate sash indicating diplomatic status, often bearing national or organizational colors and symbols.

Name: Entertainer's Outfit
Description: Colorful, eye-catching clothing suitable for performers like bards, acrobats, or actors.

Name: Executioner's Outfit
Description: Dark, hooded clothing worn by executioners to conceal identity during public executions.

Name: Explorer's Outfit
Description: Durable clothing for adventuring, including sturdy boots, practical pants, and weatherproof cloak.

Name: False Jewelry
Description: Costume jewelry made to look valuable but crafted from cheap materials. Useful for disguises.

Name: Fashionable Accessories
Description: Collection of trendy items like gloves, scarves, pins, and other accessories.

Name: Filter Scarf
Description: Cloth scarf that can be worn over nose and mouth to filter dust and irritants.

Name: Fire-Resistant Boots
Description: Boots treated with alchemical substances to resist heat and provide some protection from fire.

Name: Flame-Retardant Outfit
Description: Complete outfit treated to resist flames, useful for firefighters or those working near heat.

Name: Furs
Description: Animal pelts worn for warmth and status. Quality varies by animal type.

Name: Gambeson
Description: Padded jacket worn under armor or alone for minor protection.

Name: Gecko Gloves
Description: Special gloves with sticky palms that improve climbing ability.

Name: Hat
Description: Any style of headwear. Cost varies from simple caps to elaborate plumed hats.

Name: Headscarf
Description: Cloth worn on the head for protection from sun, cultural reasons, or fashion.

Name: Heated Gloves
Description: Insulated gloves that retain body heat, keeping hands warm in cold conditions.

Name: Hennin
Description: Tall, conical hat worn by noblewomen in certain cultures. Cost varies by decoration.

Name: Hollow-Heeled Boot
Description: Boot with a secret compartment in the heel for hiding small items.

Name: Hot Weather Outfit
Description: Light, breathable clothing designed for desert or tropical climates. Protects from sun while allowing cooling.

Name: Ice Skates
Description: Bladed footwear for gliding on ice.

Name: Inside Pocket
Description: Hidden pocket sewn into the lining of clothing for concealing small valuables.

Name: Iron Mask (common)
Description: Heavy iron mask used for punishment, restraint, or intimidation.

Name: Iron Mask (masterwork)
Description: Superior quality iron mask, better crafted and more secure.

Name: Jewelry
Description: Decorative items like rings, necklaces, bracelets. Cost and weight vary by materials.

Name: Kilt
Description: Knee-length pleated skirt, traditional garment in certain cultures.

Name: Litchina
Description: Specialized garment from specific culture, likely ceremonial or cultural significance.

Name: Lodestone Boots
Description: Boots with magnetic lodestones in the soles, useful on metal surfaces or around magnetic fields.

Name: Long Gloves
Description: Elegant gloves extending to elbow or beyond, fashionable accessory.

Name: Mask
Description: Face covering for disguise, ceremony, or protection. Cost varies by quality.

Name: Metal Glove
Description: Heavy gauntlet-like glove, provides protection and can be used as improvised weapon.

Name: Monk's Outfit
Description: Simple, loose-fitting robes suitable for meditation and martial arts practice.

Name: Monster Mask
Description: Frightening mask designed to look like a monster or creature.

Name: Neck Guard
Description: Padded or reinforced collar protecting the neck.

Name: Noble's Outfit
Description: Luxurious clothing befitting nobility, with fine fabrics, jewelry, and accessories.

Name: Ostentatious Garment
Description: Flashy, attention-grabbing piece of clothing designed to impress or distract.

Name: Patchwork Cloak
Description: Cloak made from mismatched fabric scraps, cheap but functional.

Name: Peasant's Outfit
Description: Simple, rough clothing worn by commoners and laborers.

Name: Pickpocket's Outfit
Description: Unremarkable street clothes with many hidden pockets for stolen goods.

Name: Pirate Clothes (basic)
Description: Simple sailor's garb suitable for seafaring work.

Name: Pirate Clothes (fancy)
Description: Flamboyant captain's outfit with tricorn hat, sash, and dramatic coat.

Name: Poncho
Description: Simple rain cloak, blanket with head hole, practical in wet weather.

Name: Reversible Cloak
Description: Cloak with different colors or patterns on each side, useful for quick disguise changes.

Name: Royal Outfit
Description: Magnificent clothing fit for royalty, incorporating the finest materials and jewels.

Name: Scarf
Description: Length of cloth worn around neck or head for warmth or fashion.

Name: Scarf (pocketed)
Description: Scarf with hidden pockets sewn into it for concealing small items.

Name: Scarf (reinforced)
Description: Scarf woven with wire or chain, can be used for climbing or as improvised weapon.

Name: Scholar's Outfit
Description: Practical robes with many pockets for scrolls, books, and writing implements.

Name: Shinobi Shozoku
Description: Traditional ninja outfit, dark and form-fitting for stealth operations.

Name: Signifer Mask
Description: Ceremonial mask worn by Hellknight signifers (magic users).

Name: Signifier Mask
Description: Alternate spelling/variant of Signifer Mask.

Name: Silk Kimono
Description: Elegant silk robe from Tian Xia, highly valued for quality and artistry.

Name: Skates
Description: Wheeled footwear for gliding on smooth surfaces.

Name: Skis
Description: Long boards strapped to feet for gliding over snow.

Name: Snow Goggles
Description: Protective eyewear preventing snow blindness and reducing glare.

Name: Snowshoes
Description: Wide frames worn on feet to distribute weight, preventing sinking in deep snow.

Name: Softpaw Boots
Description: Soft-soled boots that muffle footsteps, granting bonuses to stealth.

Name: Soldier's Uniform
Description: Standard military dress identifying wearer's allegiance and rank.

Name: Sparring Gear
Description: Padded protective equipment for combat training.

Name: Speed Sheath
Description: Specially designed sheath allowing faster weapon drawing.

Name: Spiritual Leader's Vestments
Description: Elaborate ceremonial robes worn by high-ranking religious figures.

Name: Sponge Suit
Description: Suit made of absorbent material. Weighs 2 lbs dry, 10 lbs when saturated.

Name: Squire's Outfit
Description: Practical clothing for a knight's servant, durable and functional.

Name: Stiletto Boots
Description: Boots with concealed blade in heel or toe, serving as hidden weapon.

Name: Straitjacket (common)
Description: Restraining garment that binds arms, used on dangerous individuals.

Name: Straitjacket (masterwork)
Description: Superior quality straitjacket, harder to escape from.

Name: Sunblock Kohl
Description: Eye makeup that reduces sun glare, popular in desert regions.

Name: Tabard
Description: Sleeveless overgarment displaying heraldry or symbols.

Name: Tear-Away Clothing
Description: Clothing designed to rip away easily, useful for escape artists. Cost added to base garment.

Name: Track-Obscuring Soles
Description: Boot attachments that leave misleading or unclear footprints.

Name: Traveler's Outfit
Description: Durable, practical clothing for long journeys.

Name: Veil
Description: Sheer fabric worn over face for modesty, ceremony, or concealment.

Name: Vest
Description: Sleeveless garment worn over shirt. Cost varies by quality.

Name: Wading Boots
Description: Tall, waterproof boots for wading through water.

Name: Wet Suit
Description: Tight-fitting waterproof garment for swimming or diving.

Name: Wig
Description: False hair for disguise or fashion. Cost and weight vary by quality and elaborateness.

Name: Wing Cloak
Description: Magical or mechanical cloak that allows limited gliding or flight.

Name: Wrangler's Gloves
Description: Thick leather gloves for handling dangerous animals or rough materials.
